summary: Store plan data under refs/ldd/plans/<id> and move every stored plan there
riskReason: Every stored plan moves, in this repo and both scenario repos, and the old refs have to be removed on GitHub too. A half-done move leaves plans in two places.

change.to: one refspec, refs/ldd/*, for fetch and push

rules.text: each stored plan is moved with its full event history: the new ref points at the old tip, created with a compare-and-swap against the zero ID, and the old ref is deleted with a compare-and-swap against that tip
the move covers this repo (#1 to #4) and both scenario repos (coupons #1 and #2, soft-delete #7 and #8)
the human pushes the moved refs and deletes the old refs on GitHub; the agent never pushes
refs/ldd/config from #1's step 1.4 keeps working under the new refspec

invariants.text: every plan's tip commit and event history are unchanged by the move
no refs/plans/* ref is left in any of the three repos

evidence: git for-each-ref refs/plans/ is empty in all three repos, and refs/ldd/plans/ lists the same IDs with the same tips as before
plan-view builds for #1 and #3 here and for #7 in the soft-delete repo
git ls-remote shows refs/ldd/plans/* and no refs/plans/* on all three GitHub repos, after the human pushes
